01 / THE BRIEF

Learning a new ecosystem.

The OSM System project put me in the .NET ecosystem: MVC structure, Razor layouts and a SQL Server database called OSM_System, with OpenStreetMap as the mapping layer.

.NETMVCRazor / LayoutsSQL ServerOpenStreetMap
“A new stack is just a new set of conventions. Learn them fast.”
THE BUILD PRINCIPLE
02 / WHAT I BUILT

Troubleshooting as a skill.

A big part of this project was getting a new stack to cooperate.

  • Resolving port conflicts.
  • Fixing MVC and Razor layout issues.
  • Database integration and troubleshooting on SQL Server.
MVC→Razor→SQL Server→OpenStreetMap
WHAT THIS PROJECT BROUGHT TOGETHER

MVC structure

Controllers, views and layouts wired together.

Database

SQL Server integration for OSM_System.

Maps

OpenStreetMap as the location layer.

03 / THE TAKEAWAY

What it
taught me.

Being comfortable outside my main stack makes me more useful on a team. The principles carry over; the syntax is just syntax.
